source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer document, six months ended 28 February 2026, consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, unit R thousand. Interim column, so it is not comparable with the annual columns beside it. Cost of sales is the printed property expenses 569,593 plus expected credit loss 25,862. Gross profit is revenue less that cost of sales; the 119 sundry income sits in operating expenses, so operating expenses of 30,643 are administrative and corporate expenses 55,614 less fair value gains 18,689, less share of income from joint venture 6,163, plus sundry income 119. EBIT is the printed profit before finance costs 451,939, and profit before tax equals EBIT less net finance costs of 182,192 exactly. EPS is basic and diluted income per share of 100.61 cents. Ratios: half-year profit over period-end totals (assets 11,583,104, equity 6,644,076, liabilities 4,939,028), not annualised. || Yahoo Finance | 2026-10-25 gap fill: FY2021 (year ended 31 August 2021) from the audited Consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, Octodec Investments Integrated Annual Report FY2022, page 103, R thousand scaled to rand. Calibrated on the same statement's FY2022 column, which reproduces the stored FY2022 Profit Before Tax 621 097, Income Tax 15 970 and Net Profit 605 127 exactly. FY2021 column: loss before taxation 115 089, taxation charge 59 730, loss attributable to shareholders 174 819, and the printed loss per share of 65.7 cents agrees with the stored EPS of -0.6567. Revenue, Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses and Operating Profit are left empty because the stored Revenue row does not reproduce the printed revenue (FY2022 stored 1 887 370 against a printed 1 939 072), so those rows use a definition this statement does not expose and cannot be filled from it without mixing bases. | CRON 20261025_155306: period columns and blank cells synchronised between the OCT and OCT.JO keys from whichever of the two already held the verified figures (same company name and currency, no value overwritten where the two disagreed); no new figure was collected in this step.
